why_this_file_exists: A 2026-11-20 verification pass found the site citing Program Policies '2(t)', '2(v)' and a shortener rule under '2(b)'. All three clauses exist, but in Associates Program Participation Requirements SECTION 6 ('Content on your Site'), subsections (t), (v) and (w) - not in Section 2. Section 2 covers 'Links on Your Site' and has only subsections (a) and (b). This file records the clause numbers and the quoted wording that were actually read on the live page, so any future citation can be checked against it instead of being guessed. Every entry below was read on the date in verified_on.

S02.title: Associates Program Policies (contains Associates Program Participation Requirements)
S02.note: Section 2 'Links on Your Site' has subsections (a) Special Links and (b) General Requirements Applicable to All Special Links. Section 6 'Content on your Site' runs (a) through (z).

clauses.heading: Identifying Yourself as an Associate
clauses.required_statement: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
clauses.quote: You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site or any other location where Amazon may authorize your display or other use of Program Content: "As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases."

clauses.heading: Term and Termination
clauses.quote: any violation of Section 5 and as specified in the Program Policies will be deemed a material breach of this Agreement.
clauses.cited_by_site_for: why a missing disclosure is treated as a material breach

clauses.heading: Suitability
clauses.quote: You will not … include any trademark of Amazon or its affiliates, or a variant or misspelling of a trademark of Amazon or its affiliates in any domain name, subdomain name, in any “tag” or Associates ID, or in any username, group name, or other identifier on any social networking site
clauses.cited_by_site_for: why the site is called Kitchen Counter and no address or handle on it contains an Amazon Mark

clauses.heading: Special Links
clauses.quote: Special Links must use the Associates ID we have assigned to you.
clauses.cited_by_site_for: the tag requirement on every outbound link

clauses.heading: General Requirements Applicable to All Special Links
clauses.quote: All Special Links must be accessed directly from your Site. For example, you must include your Associates ID or "tag" ... as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.
clauses.cited_by_site_for: the tag parameter, and the rule that links are placed on the site itself rather than handed out for others to post

clauses.heading: General Requirements Applicable to All Special Links
clauses.quote: your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements regarding use of Creators API or PA API in the License.
clauses.cited_by_site_for: why no price is rendered anywhere on the site

clauses.heading: General Requirements Applicable to All Special Links
clauses.quote: You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product, an Amazon Site, or any of our policies, promotions, or prices. For example, if you include on your Site a link to a 64 GB smartphone sold on an Amazon Site, you may not state that you are linking to a smartphone that has 128 GB of memory.
clauses.cited_by_site_for: why seller-stated claims are attributed and conflicting listing values are shown both ways

clauses.heading: General Requirements Applicable to All Special Links
clauses.quote: Under no circumstances may you associate any sub-tag, other ID or reporting provided in connection with the Associates Program with a specific end user of your Site (e.g., you may not dynamically assign sub-tags to users as they arrive on your Site for purposes of monitoring such users' behavior).
clauses.cited_by_site_for: why the click counter is aggregate and stores no per-visitor identifier

clauses.heading: General Requirements Applicable to All Special Links
clauses.quote: When linking to pages with Product lists you must have additional original content on your Site that is relevant to the Special Link.
clauses.cited_by_site_for: why the site carries original guides rather than bare links

clauses.heading: Commission Income Statement — Disqualified Purchases
clauses.quote: any Product purchase that is not correctly tracked or reported because the links from your site to the relevant Amazon Site are not properly formatted
clauses.cited_by_site_for: why an untagged or badly formatted link costs earnings rather than breaking the page (FLG-026, Q-28)

clauses.heading: Responsibility for Your Site
clauses.quote: disclosing on your Site accurately and adequately and otherwise satisfying applicable legal requirements, either through a privacy policy or otherwise, the use of cookies, pixels, and other technologies by you and third parties and how you collect, use, store, and disclose data collected from visitors
clauses.supersedes_citation: S02 s.6(e) — published that way on 2026-11-20 in the FLG-037 correction pass; the live page carries this wording under Section 3 item (e), and Section 6 item (e) is the search-engine clause. Renumbered after re-reading the page the same day (session 52f418e7).

clauses.heading: Promotional Limitations
clauses.quote: You may include Special Links in emails, SMS and direct messaging from your social media Sites; provided, that such communications are solicited (i.e., opted into by the receiving customer) … you are the “Sender” of each communication containing any Special Links
clauses.cited_by_site_for: the condition attached to any future reader email list (SG-45)

clauses.heading: Distribution of Special Links Through Software and Devices
clauses.quote: You will not, without or express prior written approval, use, or allow any third party to use, any Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models or related technology.
clauses.cited_by_site_for: the limit on any model trained with Program Content (SG-43)

clauses.heading: Content on your Site
clauses.quote: You will not bid on or purchase keywords, search terms, or other identifiers, including the word “amazon,” “Kindle,” or any other trademark of Amazon or its affiliates or variations or misspellings of any of these words (“Proprietary Terms” …) or otherwise participate in keyword auctions on any Search Engine if the resulting paid search advertisement is a Prohibited Paid Search Placement … You may purchase paid search advertisements and submit links to Search Engines to appear in response to a general Internet search query or keyword … so long as you comply with the Agreement and those paid or unpaid search results send users to your site and not directly, or indirectly via a Redirecting Link … to an Amazon Site.
clauses.cited_by_site_for: what a paid search plan may and may not buy (SG-44)

clauses.heading: Content on your Site
clauses.quote: You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements for Creators API and PA API described in the License.
clauses.cited_by_site_for: why no customer star rating or rating count is displayed

clauses.heading: Content on your Site
clauses.quote: You will not cloak, hide, spoof, or otherwise obscure the URL of your Site containing Special Links (including by use of Redirecting Links) or the user agent of the application in which Program Content is displayed or used such that we cannot reasonably determine the site or application from which a customer clicks through such Special Link to an Amazon Site.
clauses.cited_by_site_for: why the site does not cloak the referring page

clauses.heading: Content on your Site
clauses.quote: You will not use a link shortening service, button, hyperlink or other ad placement in a manner that makes it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site.
clauses.cited_by_site_for: the supplied short links: whether a short link is ambiguous is judged by the reader's certainty, not by the domain
clauses.supersedes_citation: S02 s.2(b) shortener - wrong section; corrected 2026-11-20

clauses.heading: Content on your Site
clauses.quote: Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality.
clauses.cited_by_site_for: why no price history or price alert feature is proposed

method: Each clause was read on the live page on 2026-11-20 by fetching the URL in documents above and locating the section heading and subsection letter. Quotes are transcribed from that read. Where an older site citation used a different number, the supersedes_citation field records it so a reader can see the correction rather than a silent rewrite.
gate: tools/check_site.py D30 fails the release if any data file or published page cites a Program Policies clause whose number is not in this map, or re-uses a retired number.
note: Sections 1(g), 4, 5, 6(e) and 6(f) were added on 2026-11-20 (session 52f418e7) from the same live read; the cookies clause was renumbered from 6(e) to 3(e), because Section 6(e) is the search-engine exclusion. Quotes are transcribed, not paraphrased.
